title: PACE: Provenance-Aware Capability Enforcement for Tool-Using LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.01349v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents turn generated text into real side effects, so poisoned tool metadata, retrieved pages, memory, and reusable skills can steer the next call. Vetting an artifact before admission does not settle this. A safe variant and a leaking variant can produce the same admission evidence, and a sound gate then cannot relax that site for either. We make that condition precise, which leaves the last boundary a deployment can still act on. We present Provenance-Aware Capability Enforcement (PACE), which mediates every tool call immediately before it executes. Path confinement proposes an executable cut of represented influence paths, while capability and effect verification checks schema-defined effects against authority compiled from the authenticated request. We distinguish the certified execution contract from the evaluated configuration, which can restore an authorized call after a proposed block or ap

translated_title: PACE：面向工具使用型大语言模型智能体的溯源感知能力强制执行机制
translated_abstract: 工具使用型大语言模型（LLM）智能体会将生成的文本转化为真实的副作用，因此被投毒的工具元数据、检索到的网页、记忆和可复用技能都可能操控下一次调用。仅在准入时对工件进行审查并不能解决这个问题：一个安全的变体和一个泄露信息的变体可能产生相同的准入证据，因而一个健全的网关无法对二者都放宽该检查点。我们精确刻画了这一条件，这也是部署中最后一个可以实际操作的边界。我们提出了溯源感知能力强制执行机制（PACE），它在每次工具调用执行之前立即进行中介。路径约束对所表示的影响路径提出可执行的切断方案，而能力与效果验证则根据从经过认证的请求编译出的权限来检查模式定义的效果。我们将经过认证的执行契约与被评估的配置区分开来，从而可以在提议的阻止之后恢复被授权的调用……
tldr: PACE提出了一种在每次工具调用执行前即时中介的溯源感知能力强制执行机制，通过路径约束与基于认证权限的能力效果验证，防御被投毒的工具元数据、网页和记忆对LLM智能体后续调用的操控。
en_tdlr: PACE introduces a provenance-aware capability enforcement that mediates every tool call immediately before execution, combining path confinement with capability and effect verification compiled from authenticated requests to defend tool-using LLM agents against poisoned artifacts steering their actions.
